name: Halych-Volhynia occupation
alt: Western Cumania (steppe west of the Don, Cliopatria's mis-attribution)

successors.name: Mongol Empire
successors.text: the steppe of the row, taken by the Mongols in 1236-1241 and held by the Ulus Jochi

ledger.x: 1056: Cliopatria begins a 'Halych-Volhynia occupation' row on the Pontic steppe.
1240: the row ends with the Mongol invasion.

wars.name: Roman Mstislavich's campaigns against the Cumans
wars.outcome: 'mounted two successful campaigns against the Cumans, in 1201-2 and 1203-4'; the page gives no territorial result.

wars.name: Daniel of Galicia against the Bolokhoveni
wars.outcome: The Bolokhovian princes 'were in constant conflict with Daniel, the prince of Galicia-Volhynia, between 1231 and 1257' and 'disappeared after Daniel defeated them in 1257'; they besieged Kamianets-Podilskyi in 1233 or 1235 and 1236, and Daniel 'invaded and…

wars.name: Mongol invasion of Kievan Rus' (Galicia-Volhynia, 1240-1241)
wars.outcome: The Mongols devastated Halych and Volodymyr in 1240 ('the cities of Halych and Volodymyr were devastated by the Mongols'); Daniel pledged allegiance to Batu in 1246 and paid tribute.

certainty.note: The row has no frontier of its own: the steppe edges are approximate and the dossier carries no territory.
